review_comment: The code constructs a command using potentially attacker-controlled inputs (npath from os.listdir() and args from metadata) and executes it via os.system without sanitization. The npath variable is built from a directory path and filename from os.listdir(), while args contain data from client metadata that may be attacker-influenced. This creates a command injection vulnerability where an attacker could manipulate script names or metadata values to execute arbitrary commands on the server. Implement strict input validation or parameterized execution before calling external processes.
